verses.text: Then I said: “Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?

xrefs.text: Then I said, “They are only the poor; they have played the fool, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.
[“]Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
A Psalm of Asaph. God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David— you and your officials and your people who enter these gates.

verses.text: You hate good and love evil. You tear the skin from my people and strip the flesh from their bones.

xrefs.text: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.
Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.
Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
When Elijah arrived, Ahab said to him, “So you have found me out, my enemy.” He replied, “I have found you out because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the LORD.
Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.

verses.text: You eat the flesh of my people after stripping off their skin and breaking their bones. You chop them up like flesh for the cooking pot, like meat in a cauldron.”

xrefs.text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
They are saying, ‘Is not the time near to build houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.’
You have multiplied those you killed in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.

verses.text: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but He will not answer them. At that time He will hide His face from them because of the evil they have done.

xrefs.text: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.

verses.text: This is what the LORD says: “As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:

xrefs.text: “The prophets are prophesying lies in My name,” replied the LORD. “I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, a worthless divination, the futility and delusion of their own minds.
They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.

“Indeed,” declares the LORD, “I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies. It was not I who sent them or commanded them, and they are of no benefit at all to these people,” declares the LORD.
Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built,
The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour the people, seize the treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.

verses.text: Therefore night will come over you without visions, and darkness without divination. The sun will set on these prophets, and the daylight will turn black over them.

xrefs.text: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.
For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.
And in that day, declares the Lord GOD, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the daytime.
Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.

And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

verses.text: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced. They will all cover their mouths because there is no answer from God.”

And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Put on your turban and strap your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips or eat the bread of mourners.”
So take your stand with your spells and with your many sorceries, with which you have wearied yourself from your youth. Perhaps you will succeed; perhaps you will inspire terror!
Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord GOD, when I will send a famine on the land— not a famine of bread or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.

verses.text: As for me, however, I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD, with justice and courage, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.

xrefs.text: “Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.
We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.
My message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,
The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him— the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD.
For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.

verses.text: Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,

xrefs.text: Your rulers are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chasing after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the plea of the widow never comes before them.
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous— both are detestable to the LORD.
‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
Then I said: “Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?

verses.text: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity.

xrefs.text: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
“Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms without justice, who makes his countrymen serve without pay, and fails to pay their wages,
All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!
The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour the people, seize the treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.
Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.

verses.text: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”

xrefs.text: “For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
Your rulers are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chasing after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the plea of the widow never comes before them.

verses.text: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.

xrefs.text: “Micah the Moreshite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and told all the people of Judah that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.’
A Psalm of Asaph. The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.
Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field, a planting area for a vineyard. I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations.
